plans.note: No limitation-of-liability heading in the outline; check sec-12 (indemnity) for embedded liability language and the unsupplied sections 3, 4, 6, 9, 11. If truly absent, flag as missing and seek a mutual cap with standard carve-outs.

Sec-12 is the indemnity home; confirm TrueLink indemnifies us for third-party IP and its misconduct and that Client's indemnity (likely tied to sec-8 covenants and sec-7 e-mail compliance) stays narrow and is not one-way.
Scan Client covenants (sec-8) and the licence grant (sec-2) for any restriction on the businesses or sites we may operate; no dedicated non-compete appears in the outline.
Hosting deals often make TrueLink the exclusive host; check sec-2 licence/hosting scope, the 'Hosting Services' definition in sec-1, and Client covenants in sec-8 for sole-source language.
Compensation (sec-5) is the only plausible home for pricing parity; MFN running against us is unlikely but confirm no 'best terms to TrueLink' undertaking.

No non-solicitation heading; check the tail of Client covenants (sec-8) and confidentiality (sec-10) where personnel restrictions sometimes sit. Acceptable only if narrow, time-limited and with a general-advertising carve-out.

Term and termination are almost certainly in the unsupplied sections (3, 4, 6, 9 or 11); request those before concluding. Confirm Client may terminate on notice without penalty and TrueLink cannot exit mid-term at will.
Auto-renewal and any renewal price uplift would sit with the term clause (unsupplied sections) or in compensation (sec-5); check notice window length and exit mechanics.

No general/miscellaneous section supplied; governing law is likely in an unnumbered boilerplate section beyond sec-12. Confirm NY, DE, CA or England and Wales with courts rather than foreign arbitration.

Assignment/change-of-control boilerplate is not in the supplied outline; look in the unsupplied miscellaneous sections. We need affiliate and successor assignment rights and no TrueLink exit on our change of control.

Check sec-2 licence grant and sec-1 definitions for ownership of the hosted site, Client content and customer data, and sec-10 for any confidentiality-based claim over our data; no assignment of our IP or data to TrueLink.
Primary target: sec-2 licence grant read with the sec-1 definitions. Verify the grant extends to our affiliates and contractors and is not revocable at TrueLink's discretion.

No audit heading; usage or records audit rights, if any, would sit in compensation (sec-5) or Client covenants (sec-8). If present, require notice, limited frequency, off-site review and TrueLink's cost.
Check sec-5 for penalties, late fees or fixed damages payable by Client, and sec-7 for per-message penalties tied to unsolicited e-mail; service credits in our favour are fine.

Sec-8 covers Client warranties only; TrueLink's performance/hosting warranty and any disclaimer are likely in the unsupplied sections 3, 4, 6, 9 or 11. Confirm a meaningful warranty period and a real remedy.
No insurance heading; occasionally bundled with indemnity (sec-12). TrueLink hosts our site and data, so if absent we should request standard coverage including tech E&O/cyber.
Review sec-5 for minimum fees, guaranteed volumes or take-or-pay hosting commitments; any minimum needs an exit or termination right.

No termination-assistance section in the outline; check sec-10 for return/destruction of confidential materials and the unsupplied termination sections. We need return of our data in usable form plus migration help.
